Subject: Pilot demo scheduling — proposed slots + prep

Hi Daniel,

Thanks again for the time last week — excited to get the Pioneer Health pilot scheduled. To make the session useful for both procurement and the technical team, propose the following 60-minute windows (approximate agenda attached):

- Tue Jun 8, 10:00–11:00 PT (1 PM ET)
- Wed Jun 9, 14:00–15:00 PT (5 PM ET)
- Thu Jun 10, 08:30–09:30 PT (11:30 AM ET)

Agenda highlights: quick recap, demo of our routing & batching optimizations, Q&A for procurement on data handling and SLA, next steps + MAP. I attached a short prep doc and a draft mutual-action-plan for procurement review.

If any of those slots won't work for the CFO or procurement, tell me the range that works and we'll align.

Thanks,
Marcus

Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 11:42:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Pilot demo scheduling — proposed slots + prep

Marcus — thanks for the options and the prep materials. Heads up: our CFO is unexpectedly traveling for a week of audits starting next Monday, and the finance team just put a temporary spend-latch in place while they complete an FY reforecast.

What that means for us: procurement won't sign off on pilot POs until the reforecast completes (expect late June). The CFO would like to be present for the pilot decision, so we should probably pause scheduling until after June 25.

That said, we're still interested. Two quick asks:
- Can you share a short recording or a 20–30 minute technical preview for our engineering leads this week (without procurement/CFO)?
- Can you hold a tentative slot the week of Jun 28 for a formal demo that includes procurement and the CFO?

I'll loop back with exact availability once the reforecast clears. Apologies for the churn — want to avoid running the pilot without finance alignment.

Best,
Daniel Park
Senior Product Manager, Data & Analytics
Pioneer Health
daniel.park@pioneerhealth.com
